MEDIUM CLIMATE (Indoor only)

It is brachycephalic (flat-faced) and cannot pant efficiently, which makes heat dangerous — but its short single coat also gives no cold protection. risk: Low – friendly, sociable, rarely aggressive; good with children & elderly
nutrition: High-quality easily-digestible diet; avoid foods triggering flatulence; small frequent meals; weight management essential — obesity worsens breathing (AKC – French Bulldog)

name: Saint Bernard
energy: Low–Medium – 30–45 min daily; giant breed; avoid overexertion
grooming: High – long-haired variety needs daily brush; short-haired weekly; heavy drooler — regular face wiping needed; seasonal shedding
climate:
COLD CLIMATE
Best cities (Ideal): Shimla (avg 5–25°C – excellent), Manali (avg -5 to 20°C – ideal), Srinagar (avg 0–30°C – very good), Dehradun (avg 8–30°C – good)
Manageable with: Absolutely requires 24/7 heavy-duty AC in South/Central India — this is not practical or ethical for this breed in Hyderabad/Chennai/Mumbai/Bangalore. Heat stroke risk above 25°C. Saint Bernard is ONLY suitable for North India hill stations or homes with industrial-grade cooling infrastructure.
house: High – very large indoor space + yard
cost:
Rs.20,000 – Rs.40,000/month
[Breakdown: Food Rs.9,000–15,000 | Grooming Rs.2,000–4,000 | Vet/vaccines Rs.4,000–10,000 | AC electricity cost Rs.3,000–6,000 | Supplies Rs.800–1,500 | Misc Rs.1,200–2,500]
Note: One of the most expensive breeds to maintain in India. AC and food costs dominate.
Source: Heads Up For Tails India; Supertails.com India breed cost estimates
health: Bloat/GDV (very high risk), hip & elbow dysplasia, osteosarcoma, dilated cardiomyopathy, Wobbler syndrome, eye problems (entropion/ectropion) (Wikipedia – St. Bernard; AKC – Saint Bernard)
risk: Low – gentle, patient, excellent with children & elderly; very tolerant temperament; may accidentally knock over small children due to giant size
nutrition: Giant-breed specific diet; controlled calcium & phosphorus for puppy growth; multiple small meals daily to manage severe bloat risk; joint supplements (AKC – Saint Bernard)
